memories.title: Sunflower
memories.heading: The First Little Dream I Fulfilled
memories.story: Pakhi, eta tomar deya amar first kono dream. Ekbar bolesila sunflower dite. Kothay kothay ami eta likhe rekhechilam. Ek jaigai erokom seta ami disilam. First dream which ami puron koresi.
memories.caption: Your sunflower wish. My first little promise to remember.

memories.title: Mehendi
memories.heading: A Little Art of Yours
memories.caption: One of those little things that make you, you.

memories.title: TSC Date
memories.heading: A Day at TSC
memories.story: TSC date and dolonchapa. Rickshaw diye ghura. Ei gular modhe amar oneek favourite. Tomake dolonchapa kine disi. Tumi bolsila, puron koresi as an artist.
memories.caption: Dolonchapa, rickshaw rides, and a day I wish I could relive.

memories.title: Boat Ride
memories.heading: Somewhere on the Water
memories.story: Noukae ghura amar shob favourite memory-r modhye ekta.
memories.caption: One of my favourite memories, floating somewhere between the moment and forever.
